_meta.note: Named leg poses. Each key may be a joint TYPE (e.g. 'hip_pitch' -> both legs) or a full joint_name (e.g. 'left_hip_pitch' -> that joint only, overrides the type). Any leg joint NOT named in a pose is SKIPPED (left uncommanded/DISABLED). Joints/types in 'always_skip' are skipped in every pose. knee 0deg is a hardstop -- keep it a few degrees positive.

standing._comment: PLACEHOLDER standing pose (straight legs, feet planted). Tune these values for your robot; free-standing balance still needs the IMU/policy.
